<!--
  The frame of a signed-in app with a first screen in it. Axes: layout (sidebar: navigation on the left, top: a
  bar above the content, panes: a narrow navigation, a list and a detail), density. The collapse of the sidebar
  is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { AppNav, AppUser } from "./app-shell.types";
import type { NavLink, NavSearch } from "./nav-bar.types";
import type { Metric } from "./metric-row.types";
import type { Point } from "./chart-panel.types";
import type { Event } from "./activity-feed.types";
import type { OverviewChart, OverviewActivity } from "./dashboard-overview.types";

export type AppShellProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  nav: AppNav;
  user: AppUser;
  search: NavSearch;
  metrics: Metric[];
  chart: OverviewChart;
  activity: OverviewActivity;
  layout?: "sidebar" | "top" | "panes";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import AppMain from "../components/app-main.vue";
import NavBar from "../blocks/nav-bar.vue";
import Panel from "../components/panel.vue";
import SidebarNav from "../blocks/sidebar-nav.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  nav,
  user,
  search,
  metrics,
  chart,
  activity,
  layout = "sidebar",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<AppShellProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    class="bg-background"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl('{0}-title', id))"
    data-testid="app-shell"
    :data-layout="layout"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'top')" gap="6" align="stretch">
      <NavBar
        :label="nav.label"
        :brand="nav.brand"
        :links="nav.links"
        :current="nav.current"
        :search="search"
        :actions="{ mode: 'none' }"
        layout="search"
        :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
      />
      <Container :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'pb-8')" data-slot="container">
        <AppMain
          :id="id"
          :title="title"
          :metrics="metrics"
          :chart="chart"
          cols="1-4"
          :activity="activity"
          :density="density"
        />
      </Container>
    </Stack>
    <Container v-else :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'py-8')" data-slot="container">
      <Grid
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'sidebar')"
        cols="1"
        class="items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-[16rem_minmax(0,1fr)]"
      >
        <SidebarNav
          :label="nav.label"
          :brand="nav.brand"
          :links="nav.links"
          :current="nav.current"
          :userName="user.name"
          :userEmail="user.email"
          :density="density"
          :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
        />
        <AppMain :id="id" :title="title" :metrics="metrics" :chart="chart" :activity="activity" :density="density" />
      </Grid>
      <Grid v-else cols="1-3" class="items-start gap-4">
        <SidebarNav
          :label="nav.label"
          :brand="nav.brand"
          :links="nav.links"
          :current="nav.current"
          :userName="user.name"
          :userEmail="user.email"
          width="compact"
          :density="density"
          :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
        />
        <Panel :title="activity.title" :description="activity.text" :id="tpl('{0}-list', id)">
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0" data-testid="items">
            <ListItem v-for="e in activity.events" :key="e.id" class="flex flex-col gap-2" data-testid="item">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {{ e.title }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ e.time }}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Panel>
        <AppMain :id="id" :title="title" :metrics="metrics" :chart="chart" density="compact" />
      </Grid>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
